base_pool.definition: Wave53 Q50 motor2>=+0.1 and motor3>=0.0 + p3>=0.20, outside Wave36 p3>=0.365448

method: Reproduce Wave36 p3 with February-trained shrinkage LDA and exact 63 static pre-deadline features; use February-derived quantile cuts for boat3 player strength and ST environment; inspect 180-230R region and chronological early/late halves. March outcomes used only for diagnostic evaluation, not production promotion.

best_around_200_single.rule: boat3 national2 minus boat1 national2 >= +9.8pt (February Q80 cut)

best_pair_180_220.rule: boat3 national2 >= 23.8 (February Q25) AND boat1 avg ST <= 0.17

conclusion: The target improves materially from 29.0% to 33.81% while retaining 210R, but the tested frozen February-derived player/ST refinements do not reach 35% at roughly 200R. The strongest volume-preserving signal is boat3-vs-boat1 national 2-place-rate gap >= +9.8pt. Early/late stability is good (34.62% / 33.02%). Keep as diagnostic research hypothesis; no production adoption.
